تخترطي (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِطِي (taḵtariṭī) /tax.ta.ri.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# تُخْتَرَطِي (tuḵtaraṭī) /tux.ta.ra.tˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
